name: entries
sql:
CREATE TABLE entries (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(type) <> ''),
    cover_ref TEXT,
    preview_ref TEXT,
    upload_date TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
, page_count INTEGER, preview_refs TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', sync_uid TEXT
  CHECK (
    sync_uid IS NULL OR (
      length(sync_uid) = 36 AND
      substr(sync_uid, 9, 1) = '-' AND
      substr(sync_uid, 14, 1) = '-' AND
      substr(sync_uid, 19, 1) = '-' AND
      substr(sync_uid, 24, 1) = '-'
    )
  ), sync_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  CHECK (sync_version >= 1), duration_seconds INTEGER)

name: tag_groups
sql:
CREATE TABLE tag_groups (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    entry_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(entry_type) <> ''),
    name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    group_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (group_kind IN ('section', 'facet')),
    parent_id INTEGER,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, sync_uid TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tag_groups(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CHECK (
        (group_kind = 'section' AND parent_id IS NULL AND trim(name) <> '') OR
        (group_kind = 'facet' AND parent_id IS NOT NULL)
    )
)

name: collections
sql:
CREATE TABLE collections (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('entry', 'producer')),
    title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(title) <> ''),
    description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    nsfw INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (nsfw IN (0, 1)),
    parent_id INTEGER,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, gallery_type TEXT
  CHECK (gallery_type IS NULL OR (kind = 'entry' AND length(trim(gallery_type)) > 0)), sync_uid TEXT
  CHECK (
    sync_uid IS NULL OR (
      length(sync_uid) = 36 AND substr(sync_uid, 9, 1) = '-' AND
      substr(sync_uid, 14, 1) = '-' AND substr(sync_uid, 19, 1) = '-' AND
      substr(sync_uid, 24, 1) = '-'
    )
  ), sync_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  CHECK (sync_version >= 1),
    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES collections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CHECK (parent_id IS NULL OR kind = 'entry')
)

name: site_crawl_sources
sql:
CREATE TABLE site_crawl_sources (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  source_site TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(source_site) <> ''),
  -- 'folder' covers collection / album / tag listings; the kind only labels
  -- which site listing the cursor describes, it never changes the cursor rule.
  source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_kind IN ('artist', 'folder', 'work', 'search')),
  source_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(source_ref) <> ''),
  display_name TEXT,
  source_url TEXT,
  -- Newest work already held for this source. last_seen_order_key is the
  -- forward-only high-water mark a later run compares against; the id and date
  -- beside it are what a crawler actually reads. All three move together.
  last_seen_source_id TEXT,
  last_seen_work_date TEXT,
  last_seen_order_key TEXT,
  crawl_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (crawl_count >= 0),
  first_crawled_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  last_crawled_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE (source_site, source_kind, source_ref)
)

BEFORE INSERT ON tag_groups
WHEN NEW.group_kind = 'facet'
BEGIN

        SELECT 1
        FROM tag_groups AS parent
        WHERE parent.id = NEW.parent_id
          AND parent.group_kind = 'section'
          AND parent.entry_type = NEW.entry_type
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'facet parent must be a section of the same entry type') END;
END

 AND (NEW.group_kind <> 'section' OR NEW.entry_type <> OLD.entry_type)
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tag_groups WHERE parent_id = OLD.id)

END

name: entry_tags_facet_insert

         AND facet.group_kind = 'facet'

name: rating_slots
sql:
CREATE TABLE "rating_slots" (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    subject_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_kind IN ('entry', 'producer', 'author_self')),
    entry_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(entry_type) <> ''),
    name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(name) <> ''),
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    sync_uid TEXT,
    UNIQUE (subject_kind, entry_type, name)
)

name: entry_rating_values
sql:
CREATE TABLE "entry_rating_values" (
    slot_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stars REAL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (slot_id, entry_id),
    CHECK (
        stars IS NULL
        OR (stars >= 0.5 AND stars <= 5 AND stars * 2 = CAST(stars * 2 AS INTEGER))
    ),
    FOREIGN KEY (slot_id) REFERENCES "rating_slots"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (entry_id) REFERENCES entries(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE "producer_rating_values" (

    PRIMARY KEY (slot_id, producer_id),
    CHECK (
        stars IS NULL
        OR (stars >= 0.5 AND stars <= 5 AND stars * 2 = CAST(stars * 2 AS INTEGER))
    ),
    FOREIGN KEY (slot_id) REFERENCES "rating_slots"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (producer_id) REFERENCES producers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) WITHOUT ROWID
